item.title: Las Vegas local hits $109,361 jackpot at Palms Casino Resort
item.description: A Las Vegas local won $109,361 on a slot machine at Palms Casino Resort on Thursday.

item.title: Senate passes massive government funding package, sending it to House
item.description: The Senate voted overwhelmingly Friday to pass a major funding package consisting of five regular appropriations bills and a two-week stopgap measure for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) but the legislation won’t become law before parts of the government shut down at midnight. item.title: Driver killed in Nye County crash on Wednesday identified
item.description: A driver who died in a Wednesday crash north of Pahrump was identified Friday by the Nevada Highway Patrol.

item.title: Lombardo, Colorado River governors meet with Interior Secretary as deadline approaches
item.description: Nevada Gov. Joe Lombardo and Southern Nevada's top water official were in Washington, D.C., on Friday as a Feb. 14 federal deadline nears for an agreement between seven states that depend on Colorado River water.

item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- One of the drivers involved in a deadly crash on the 215 Southern Beltway is now facing DUI and possible other charges. item.title: 'Shut it Down' protestors gather in Las Vegas
item.description: Demonstrations took place across the country Friday, following widespread outrage over the recent death of intensive care nurse Alex Pretti in Minneapolis.

item.title: Hair appointments, happy hour missed due to construction
item.description: The City of Las Vegas, along with the Regional Flood Control District have reduced Charleston to one lane due to the installation of a 8-foot by 7-foot storm drain box, due to be complete 2027. (James Schaeffer/KLAS)

item.title: Jury finds Nathan Chasing Horse guilty on 13 counts including sexual assault of a minor
item.description: Jurors convicted Nathan Chasing Horse on 10 counts of sexual assault on a minor, returning guilty verdicts on 13 of 21 counts in the actor's trial on Friday.

item.title: Las Vegas teen charged after alleged brutal group sexual assault on private school field trip caught on video
item.description: Four eighth graders at a Las Vegas private school are accused of sexually assaulting another student during a field trip to Costa Rica, with one of the students, Vaughn Griffith, charged in adult court for possession of a visual presentation depicting the sexual assault.
